index-ventures._readme: Durable identity corrections consumed by build-company-base.py on every rebuild (COLLECTION.md s8): one company under different names across Index's surfaces (the live list, the archived listings 2008-2025, Form D issuer names) and its renames. Canonical = the firm's current rendering where the company is still listed. Written at kickoff 2026-10-01 (PRO-82) before the first prepare.

merges.name: Captain Train
merges.reason: one company: Capitaine Train (the firm's 2014 page) renamed Captain Train in 2016, the year Trainline bought it; the firm's 2019-2025 pages carry it as Captain Train

merges.name: Edited
merges.reason: one company: EDITD (the firm's 2012-2014 listing) rebranded EDITED in 2015; the 2018-2023 pages carry the new spelling

merges.name: Elastic
merges.reason: one company: Elasticsearch (2013-2014 listing) renamed Elastic in 2015 (Elastic N.V., NYSE: ESTC; the Index funds' 13G filings)

merges.name: The Climate Corporation
merges.reason: one company: WeatherBill (2008-2012 listing; Form D with Neil Rimer as director) renamed The Climate Corporation in 2011; the 2014+ pages shorten it to Climate (Monsanto, 2013)

merges.name: Fuze
merges.reason: one position: FuzeBox (2012-2013 listing; Form D with Mike Volpi as director) was merged into ThinkingPhones in 2015, which renamed itself Fuze; the firm's 2014 page already reads Fuze

merges.name: Notonthehighstreet
merges.reason: one company: Notonthehighstreet (2010-2013 listing) is NOTHS on the 2014+ pages and the live list

merges.name: Super Evil Megacorp
merges.reason: one company: SUPER EVIL MEGA CORP. is the Form D spelling (Benjamin Holmes, director 2015 and 2017) of Super Evil Megacorp on the firm's list

merges.name: Trolltech
merges.reason: one company: the 2009-2013 listing reads 'Qt (formerly Trolltech) (Nokia)'; Index backed Trolltech, which Nokia bought in 2008

merges.name: Netlog
merges.reason: one company: the 2013 listing reads 'Twoo (formerly Netlog)' (Massive Media, Ghent)

merges.name: Wise
merges.reason: one company: TransferWise (2013-2021 pages) renamed Wise in 2021 (LON: WISE on the live list)

merges.name: Motive
merges.reason: one company: KeepTruckin (2018-2020 pages; Form D as Keep Truckin, Inc.) renamed Motive in 2022 (Motive Technologies, Inc.)

merges.name: GOAT
merges.reason: one company: 1661, Inc. (Culver City; 2018 Form D with Danny Rimer as director) is the legal name of GOAT

merges.name: Cloud.com
merges.reason: one company: VMOps (2010 listing) renamed Cloud.com in 2010 (Citrix, 2011)

merges.name: Covariant
merges.reason: one company: Embodied Intelligence Inc. (2021 Form D with Michael Volpi as director) is the legal name of Covariant; the 2023 Form D files as Covariant, Inc.

merges.name: Viagogo
merges.reason: one company: Pugnacious Endeavors Inc (London; Form Ds 2009-2011 with Danny Rimer as director) is the Delaware parent of viagogo

merges.name: Sofía
merges.reason: one company: Sofia Holdings Ltd (Mexico City; 2021 Form D with Neil Rimer as director) is the holding company of Sofía, which the live page credits to Neil Rimer

merges.name: Multiverse
merges.reason: one company: WhiteHat (the firm's 2020 page) renamed Multiverse in 2021

merges.name: Immersive Gamebox
merges.reason: one company: Electric Playbox (the firm's 2020 page) renamed Electric Gamebox, then Immersive Gamebox

merges.name: Rec Room
merges.reason: one company: Against Gravity (the firm's 2019 page) is the studio behind Rec Room and took its name (Rec Room Inc.)

merges.name: Quantive
merges.reason: one company: Gtmhub (2022 page; 2021 Form D as Gtmhub USA, Inc. with Martin Mignot as director) renamed Quantive in 2023

merges.name: Stack Overflow
merges.reason: one company: Stack Exchange, Inc. (2011-2020 pages; Form Ds with Neil Rimer as director) is Stack Overflow on the live list

merges.name: Loom
merges.reason: one company: Opentest, Inc. is Loom's first legal name; both Form Ds carry Ilya Fushman as director (2018 and 2019-2021)

merges.name: Cue
merges.reason: one company: CueCal, Inc. (San Francisco; 2018 Form D with Dino Becirovic as director) is the legal name of Cue, which the firm's 2020 page credits to Dino Becirovic

merges.name: Cowboy Space
merges.reason: one company: the live page reads 'Cowboy Space Corporation (formerly Aetherflux)'; the 2025 page is Aetherflux

never_merge.reason: two companies: Gather (gather.town, Gather Presence; the firm's page credits Danny Rimer) and Gather Wholesale Inc. (Walnut, CA; a 2020 Form D carrying Ilya Fushman as director two years after he left for Kleiner Perkins). The builder's prefix rule would fold the filing into the listed company.
